'''Ultraviolet-rated constable''' was, along with [[violet-rated constable]], one of two ranks of [[Officer/Legends|officers]] that formed the upper leadership of the [[Sullustan Constable Brigade]]. The Brigade was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] arm of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], which ruled the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], and all nine of its ranks, including that of ultraviolet-rated constable, were named for [[Color/Legends|colors]] on the light spectrum.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of ultraviolet-rated constable was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
